theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Euclid P) (pL : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid n), Orthonormal ℝ v → (∀ (x : Euclid P) (i : Fin n), pL x i = inner ℝ (v i) x) → ∀ (l : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Euclid n) l), covectorEuclideanNorm (γ.compContinuousLinearMap pL) = covectorEuclideanNorm γ
